text:
Priya CSM: Heads-up for QBR — Account ASTRAFIELD has an unexpected uptick in token consumption tied to embeddings. Need a crisp spend forecast + mitigation play by EOD so we can include in the renewal packet.

Marco (FinOps): on it. Recommend 3 scenarios: steady-state, projected with current trend, and worst-case if activation continues. Need last 60 days + current committed credits.

Tess (Enablement): I'll prepare a 1-page "embed hygiene" checklist for the CS team to share. Also want to confirm if any customer-facing SDK change shipped this week. @Rahul Eng?

Rahul Eng: pushed small client SDK patch last Wed that toggles a new "prefetch" param. Not enabled by default, but customers can opt-in. No server-side changes.

DevOps-Bot: Billing alert: ASTRAFIELD reached 82% of monthly token allocation. AlertID: bill-8791

Priya CSM: OK action list: Marco - 3-scenario slide + cushion recommendation. Tess - one-pager embed best practices. Rahul - confirm any telemetry showing customers flipping prefetch. I will draft a customer note offering a short consult to pin batch settings.

Marco (FinOps): quick baseline numbers attached: 
```
30d_tokens: 1,100,000
7d_tokens: 420,000
monthly_commit: 1,200,000
```

Marco (FinOps): projection (simple linear): expected_month_end = 1,500,000 (25% over commit). Worst-case (if growth persists): 2,300,000. Recommend 20% credits cushion and a temporary soft throttle at 60% until we complete onboarding check.

Tess (Enablement): drafted checklist: batching, prefix caching, reduce embed dims, async queueing, sampling rate. Will put in the QBR appendix.

Rahul Eng: telemetry shows 3 customers adopted prefetch in last 48h, ASTRAFIELD not among them.

Priya CSM: Good. I'll schedule a 30-min mitigation call with ASTRAFIELD for tomorrow, include suggested throttle + checklist. Marco please add the cost-savings estimate on applying batching (assume 2.5x reduction on embed tokens for targeted routes).

Marco (FinOps): added estimate: with batching applied to top routes, month projection drops to ~980k — back under commit. Savings slide ready.

Priya CSM: posting draft customer note now in #customer-comm for quick review. Thanks team. If billing-bot escalates, ping me directly. :phone:
